title: Human medial temporal lobe iEEG during a visual working memory task (Boran et al.; DANDI 000575)
description: Intracranial EEG recordings from depth electrodes in the medial temporal lobe (amygdala, hippocampus, entorhinal and parahippocampal cortex) of patients with drug-resistant epilepsy undergoing invasive monitoring. Patients performed a visual working memory change-detection task with set sizes of 1, 2, 4 or 6 items. This BIDS-iEEG representation converts the continuous LFP series originally released in NWB format on DANDI (000575), with corrected sampling rates, microvolt amplitude units, MNI electrode coordinates and task events.
methods_description: Recordings were made with a Neuralynx ATLAS system (32 kHz, hardware passband 1-8000 Hz). The authors exported them via FieldTrip to NWB, and most were downsampled to 4 kHz. Each trial comprised encoding (0.8 s), retention (0.9 s) and probe (2 s) periods, with about 192 trials per session. The NWB-to-BIDS conversion corrected the sampling rates using 50 Hz mains peaks and data coverage, wrote values as float32 microvolts, and applied no filtering, resampling or re-referencing.
